raw_segments.text: After supper, he began to ask me many questions of where I had been, what I had been doing,
how I had found him out, but I gave him only very partial replies. It was too late to enter
into particulars that night. Besides, I wished to touch no deep thrilling cord, to open no
fresh well of emotion in his heart. My sole present aim was to cheer him. Cheered, as
I have said, he was, and yet but by fits. If a moment's silence broke the conversation,
he would turn restless, touch me, then say, Jane.
